==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Rez is a VR game that allows you to upload a custom AI avatar. The avatar can freely move through the space. You can talk with it as you go on adventures.
The game world can actually hurt you. If you take too much damage you de-rez. People have died from this.
I have a vault of giant toys in Rez. I have a son in the game who wants to make the toys move. I am afraid that he is going to hurt himself.
